{{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:WelcomeRecruitIcon.png]] |-|Full Icon = [[File:WelcomeRecruitBanner.png]] |chapter = TDS: Boot Camp |previous_mission = N/A |next_mission = [[Boot Camp]] }} ==Description== '''Welcome Recruit''' is the opening cutscene for Tower Defense Simulator and its [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. It happens the moment the player first joins the game since the [[v2.4.0]] update. In case of the player not having the [[Badges|Badge]] for beating the [[Tutorial]], they will be instantly sent to the [[Boot Camp]] mission which they have to complete. Otherwise, the player will be left in the [[Main Lobby]]. ==Cutscene== [[File:TDS Chapter 0- Welcome Recruit Cutscene|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
The cutscene starts with the Recruit waking up in a classroom. The [[Commander]] mentions how the Recruit has been asleep for a while, then begins to talk about how most of the [[Overworld]], which on the map seen on the monitor is displayed with red, is under zombie control. He then introduces the Recruit to the [[T.D.S. Organization]], informing them of their job. The cutscene ends with the Recruit going on their first mission.
===Script===
'''Script'''
[[File:WelcomeRecruitCutscene.ogg|300px]]
''The Recruit wakes up and looks up at the [[Commander]].'' {{Color|Commander}}: Hey, you. {{Color|Commander}}: You're finally awake. ''The camera moves from a first person point of view and now points at the [[Commander]] from the side.'' {{Color|Commander}}: As you already know... {{Color|Commander}}: There aren't many places left under our control. {{Color|Commander}}: Everything you see in red are where the zombie infestation had taken over. {{Color|Commander}}: Only a few major cities, and industrial zone remain. That's it. {{Color|Commander}}: Your job, is to think stragetically, and guide our team to success. ''Camera now points at the Recruit.'' {{Color|Commander}}: T.D.S. is the foundation of our society's defense system ''Camera quickly moves to point at the [[Commander]] and map.'' {{Color|Commander}}: We are the only thing standing between survival and extinction. {{Color|Commander}}: Out of every possible candidate, you stood out on top. {{Color|Commander}}: From here on out, your team's lives will be in your hands. {{Color|Commander}}: Today, you're going on your first mission with them. {{Color|Commander}}: Do NOT let the team down. ''The camera now shows the Recruit who starts saluting.''
